Indiana Microelectronics LLC | RF Engineer | West Lafayette, IN | ONSITE | Full-time | Relocation assistance available

Indiana Micro is a small electronics company working on tunable RF filters and radio-frequency front-end (RFFE) systems for interference mitigation.

We’re looking for an RF engineer to design, simulate, test, and optimize RF hardware—from filters, amplifiers, and mixers through integrated front-end systems. You’ll work with systems engineers, firmware developers, and customers from early architecture through production.

Looking for:

- 3+ years of hands-on RF engineering, hardware design, or wireless communications experience.

- Strong RF/microwave fundamentals and experience with tools such as HFSS, Keysight ADS, Microwave Office, and Altium.

- Practical lab experience with network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and related test equipment.

- Familiarity with Python or MATLAB for test automation and data analysis.

- Bachelor’s or master’s in EE, computer engineering, electrical engineering technology, or a related field.

Benefits include retirement benefits and PTO.

Email cuppys@indianamicro.com to apply.

HiO (hio.ai) | Growth Marketing Manager | Remote (US, Eastern hours) | Full-time | $140K–$160K + equity

HiO is an AI business partner for small business owners. It works across their customer conversations on Instagram, WhatsApp, SMS and email, spots opportunities and flags what needs the owner’s attention. We’ve raised a $16M seed round and we’re a small team that moves fast.

We need our first growth hire, and you’d own the growth engine end to end. That means paid social and search with real budget accountability, SEO and visibility in AI/LLM answers, landing page and signup conversion, referral, and testing new channels and killing the ones that don’t work. You’d also build the measurement layer from scratch: funnel instrumentation, CAC/LTV and activation metrics.

There’s no dedicated growth engineer, so you’ll build your own automation: AI-assisted creative testing, automated reporting and agentic campaign workflows.

What we’re looking for: 5+ years in growth at a SaaS company (SMB or PLG at seed or Series A is ideal). You’ve owned the full funnel yourself rather than executing someone else’s strategy, and you can show specific workflows you’ve automated with AI. This is a hands-on role with no team to manage near-term.

Apply: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4468585742/

General Intelligence Holdings | https://www.generalintelligenceholdings.com | Founding CTO | REMOTE (UK working-hour overlap preferred) | Fundraising | Salary/equity to be agreed

I'm Chris, founder of GIH. We're building an AI operating platform for established service businesses, starting with UK accountancy. Our model is to acquire businesses and deploy the software into their daily workflows, measuring its effect on time, quality and cost.

We've built version 1 of Helix, connecting accounting workflows, AI assistance, source evidence and review controls. It covers work including reconciliation, payroll, VAT and debtors. The next challenge is deployment in an operating practice, including production integrations, security and independent validation.

I'm looking for a hands-on CTO to own architecture and engineering delivery, write code, work with accountants and build the technical team. You should have shipped and operated customer-facing software, be comfortable with APIs and data systems, and have practical experience evaluating LLM/agent workflows. Previous CTO experience isn't essential; evidence of building and owning a product is.

We're currently fundraising and expect the round to close at the end of November 2026. You can join when the round closes or start earlier, depending on your availability and preference. Salary, equity and any arrangements before the round closes will be agreed directly. This is intended as a full-time technical leadership role.

Email chris@generalintelligencecapital.com with “HN CTO” in the subject, your CV/LinkedIn, something you built, your location and preferred start date.

Chronograph was founded to bring next-generation technology to private capital markets. Through our suite of cloud-based analytics and data management solutions, we help many of the world's largest and most sophisticated venture capital, private equity, and credit funds understand their investment performance in unprecedented detail. As our business grows, we're expanding the team, backed by a recent $140M+ growth equity raise.
